newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Harwill H1 shr knocked, issues cautionary.
newsitem.headline: Harwill H1 shr knocked, issues cautionary.

text.p: NOTE - The company said in terms of the group policy dividends are declared after year end. It said loss-making, Pregtech had been sold on December 31, 1996, at a loss of 293,345 rand and further losses have thus been stopped.

But added, that the establishment and development of the new projects in Philippi, namely Harwill Medical, Happi Plastics and Liqui-tainers still required investments and development capital and had reflected losses for the six month which will continue for the rest of the financial year.

Harwill advised shareholders to exercise caution in their share dealings until a further notice, saying it was still involved in negotiations which if successfully concluded, may have an effect on its share price.
